title: Radar sites built 1946, plus Mori Arti and Continental bases

tellings.quote: When Scott dug into it, he found out the site was originally built in 1946 before being moved in 1950. He also [music] found two other bases close by, Mori Arti and Continental, although those weren't active until around 1950 or 51.

plain: A radar site in New Mexico that features in a claimed alien crash story was first built in 1946 and then moved in 1950, according to the digging of a man named Scott Ramsey, whose research Michels describes. Michels says Ramsey also found two other military bases nearby, called Mori Arti and Continental, though those did not become active until around 1950 or 1951. The dates matter because they would show what military equipment was watching the area at the time of the claimed crash.
